metadata.title: Manual de uso, e-Reporting Industria (DINAVISA, Departamento de Farmacovigilancia)
metadata.edition: Versión 3.0, February 2024 · e-Reporting Industria: new cases and follow-ups, E2B upload, country of the reaction; no time limit stated (Spanish)
metadata.legal_basis: DINAVISA user manual; the resoluciones it cites govern.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
